baseline.canonicalEncoding: sorted compact JSON name→{architecture,version}, followed by LF
baseline.preMutation: successful guest dpkg-query must equal entire exact declared inventory; digest equality alone without parsed equality is insufficient

bootstrap.growpart: disabled; refuse inadequate guest space rather than guessing filesystem expansion
bootstrap.method: read-only CIDATA ISO with NoCloud user-data/meta-data, frozen helper/policy/packages; no cloud-image customization or package injection before baseline observation
bootstrap.network: QEMU -nic none and no network device or host filesystem share
bootstrap.qga: owned private Unix socket and virtio-serial org.qemu.guest_agent.0 exist before launch; agent becomes available only after old phase installs it
bootstrap.rootAndEsp: observe actual root/block ancestry and existing mounts inside the exclusively owned overlay; no expected ESP UUID or mounted path guessed; no foreign disk, host block passthrough or shared filesystem

cancellationAndRetention.cancel: TERM then bounded wait/KILL only exact owned process group; reject reused/foreign PID; reap children and stop at deadline even without guest progress
cancellationAndRetention.cleanup: close/unlink only own sockets after child exit; preserve immutable inputs, overlay, serial and hashes on failure; no prune, retained fixture deletion or host package mutation
cancellationAndRetention.owner: Popen-owned process/session with executable+cmdline+start-time identity; exclusive scratch nonce and UUID
cancellationAndRetention.quota: bounded serial/result output plus guest/host capacity readback; quota failure cancels owned VM

capacity.formula: 2*cloud stored bytes + 3*actual cloud virtual bytes + 4*unique package bytes + 64MiB seed cap + 2GiB reserve
capacity.overlayStoredBytesQuota: actual virtual bytes + 512MiB; monitor and cancel on quota before filling host filesystem
capacity.requireBeforeStart: successful qemu-img actual virtual size and host free bytes; formula and 64GiB host floor must both pass

cloud.beforeExecution: complete download must match exact published size/SHA512; then pin local SHA256 and successful qemu-img info with no backing/data-file before immutable freeze

host.ownedTools: pin QEMU/qemu-img/OVMF, ISO seed builder and package/helper closure; libguestfs and Windows TPM are unnecessary for this separate run

remainingSource: NoCloud guest bootstrap typed producer and actual extracted controls
host typed serial comparator + post-old QGA readback controls
Linux-only owned launcher with no-network/device allowlist/cancellation/quota controls
source-only measured-host workflow and pinned artifact acquisition protocol
scope: independent Linux-only actual package consumer run; no Windows return, boot chain or firmware acceptance

serialProof.independentReadback: after old agent starts, positive Linux identity and current bootId via QGA; after new phase re-read actual dpkg inventory and hash-bound result in guest, not serial success alone
serialProof.publication: bounded typed JSON records from actual helper; remove stale result first, atomic success publication; host rejects missing/duplicate/out-of-order/truncated/wrong-challenge/wrong-boot/wrong-hash/nonzero records
stages: old-installed only after successful actual apt and exact after inventory
new-installed only after successful actual apt and exact after inventory
